biography.value: Abyssal Surges open with Tidal Surge to scatter enemy formations, then spend subsequent actions building Grapples through Crushing Wave while Pressurized Jet handles anything trying to disengage. Engulf removes priority targets from the engagement. In water, the Water Mastery suppression of Reflex saves makes them genuinely terrifying — everything takes full cold damage regardless of how well enemies roll. A summoner who deploys one near a sea, lake, or river should be aware that the Abyssal Surge will attempt to drag the fight into that water without prompting. That is simply what it is.

system.attacksNotes:
Crushing Wave [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (5 + 7 Str) + 4 cold damage (Half DR); target pushed 10 feet.
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 cold damage; target knocked Prone + Numbed condition; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 cold damage + Prone + Frosted; target Grappled as the wave wraps around them.

Pressurized Jet [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 5), Range: 60 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 16 cold damage (11 + 5 Dex); target pushed 10 feet.
  • Margin 2: 16 cold damage, DR halved (round up); target pushed 15 feet + Frosted; no save.
  • Margin 3: 16 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frosted + Restrained by a column of pressurized water for 1 round; Fortitude save (Hard task, 2 successes) to move through it.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Tidal Surge (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: Sends a 60-foot cone of pressurized water in a chosen direction. All creatures in the cone make a Reflex save. Compare Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7 targeting vs. each save.

  • Margin 1:: 20 cold damage (Half DR) + pushed 20 feet.
  • Margin 2: 20 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + pushed 30 feet + Prone.
  • Margin 3: 20 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + pushed 30 feet + Prone + Frosted condition.

Engulf (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: Surges over 2 Medium or 1 large creature within 5 feet. Target makes a Reflex save (compare Agil 4 + Melee Combat 5 vs. save successes). Grappled, Restrained, takes 8 cold damage per round. Fortitude [Hard] save each round to break free, or an ally can spend 2 [Interact] actions to pull them clear. Water Mastery: In water, ### Attacks against the Abyssal Surge add 1 to both dice. Its Crushing Wave reach extends to 20 ft while in water. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Abyssal Surge fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
